name: bt13-metal-renderer
title: Build targets stage 13 (later goal): a native Metal renderer for iOS and macOS
issue: User request, 2026-11-10: 'I would like for the engine to be able to allow the user to select a build target in the engine editor UI like windows, linux, android, ios, web, and maybe other console toolchains in the future like switch'. Design and stage table: orchestrator/proposals/build-targets-design.md. Stage 13 of section 5. D2 (user, 2026-11-10): native mobile rendering as a later goal. Built and tested only in GitHub Actions (D7).
acceptance: A spike first compares MoltenVK over the Vulkan renderer with a native Metal backend and records the result; the user picks before the backend is written
The ios and macos targets can select Metal; the software renderer stays the fallback
MSL shaders validated in CI; image comparison against the software renderer on the simulator and on macOS in CI
gate: later goal; needs the user's go; depends on bt10-ios-player
notes: Reviewer: interface parity with the other backends, no Objective-C leaking into renderer headers outside the Metal backend.
